decision_rule.vi: Chốt record grammar và termination trước khi đọc; chỉ commit sau khi đủ line, convert đúng type và còn capacity.
decision_rule.en: Fix record grammar and termination before reading; commit only after all lines exist, conversions succeed and capacity remains.

cases.description: read exactly the source-stated number of complete records
stop at EOF without committing a partial final record
call the supplied destination operation once per complete converted record

variants.invariant: Every committed destination element corresponds to one complete source record in file order, committed_count never exceeds capacity, and no read occurs outside the open-file interval.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Mỗi destination item đã commit tương ứng đúng một record nguồn hoàn chỉnh theo file order; count không vượt capacity và không read ngoài khoảng file mở.
invariant_bilingual.en: Every committed destination element corresponds to one complete source record in file order, committed_count never exceeds capacity, and no read occurs outside the open-file interval.

decision_rule.vi: Phân loại create, subclass-dispatch hay lookup-update trước; parse đủ typed record rồi mới construct/update và commit.
decision_rule.en: Classify create, subclass-dispatch or lookup-update first; parse the complete typed record before constructing/updating and committing.

cases.description: group fixed lines and construct one object in exact parameter order
a discriminator selects one permitted subtype
a record key locates one existing object and changes source-stated fields

variants.invariant: Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Mỗi record thành công tạo đúng một object hợp lệ hoặc cập nhật đúng một target; partial object không vào destination state.
invariant_bilingual.en: Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.

decision_rule.vi: Chốt append hay overwrite và physical hay logical order trước khi format bất kỳ dòng nào.
decision_rule.en: Fix append versus overwrite and physical versus logical order before formatting any line.

cases.description: new target contains only the required formatted records
existing prefix remains and new records form an exact suffix
write backing rows as triples when explicitly required, not traversal order

variants.invariant: The emitted suffix contains exactly the source-selected records in required order and format; append preserves the prior prefix, while overwrite obeys the new-file contract.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Output suffix chứa đúng records được chọn theo order/format nguồn; append giữ prefix cũ còn overwrite tuân hợp đồng file mới.
invariant_bilingual.en: The emitted suffix contains exactly the source-selected records in required order and format; append preserves the prior prefix, while overwrite obeys the new-file contract.
